text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of people with depression, women vs. men 2023
Estimated share of women and men who have depression, whether or not they are diagnosed, based on
representative surveys, medical data, and statistical modeling. Prevalence is measured as the share experiencing
depression at a given point in time. It does not measure lifetime prevalence.

tspan.tspan: To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, this metric is age-standardized.
